description: AllUrE India estimates urban energy use across 640 Indian districts for 2011. Its research team combines national statistics with district information to allocate electricity and fossil-fuel use across households, industry and manufacturing, transport, commercial buildings and agriculture. Figshare version 3 supplies an Excel workbook and two R scripts for allocating residential electricity and LPG consumption. The deposit states CC BY 4.0 and is freely accessible. These annual district estimates can initialize urban energy balances and compare demand assumptions in infrastructure capacity and decarbonisation simulations. They provide a different geographic application from data-eurostat-energy-statistics. A caveat is that the district values combine top-down and bottom-up estimates, not direct measurement of every urban consumer. Agreement with national totals does not demonstrate local accuracy. District boundaries and the 2011 reference year also need consideration when comparing current cities or projecting demand. The workbook and scripts were identified through repository metadata but were not downloaded or executed.
